extracted_concepts.name: Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Quantity with magnitude and direction, written as ⟨a, b, c⟩.

extracted_concepts.name: Magnitude
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Length of a vector, |v| = √(a² + b² + c²).

extracted_concepts.name: Direction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Orientation of a vector in space.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector addition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Component-wise addition u + v = ⟨u₁+v₁, u₂+v₂, u₃+v₃⟩.

extracted_concepts.name: Scalar multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Multiplying a vector by a scalar: cv = ⟨ca, cb, cc⟩.

extracted_concepts.name: Dot product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u · v = u₁v₁ + u₂v₂ + u₃v₃ = |u||v|cos θ.

extracted_concepts.name: Cross product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u × v gives a vector perpendicular to u and v.

extracted_concepts.name: Projection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Component of one vector along another, measured by the dot product.

extracted_concepts.name: Perpendicular vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector orthogonal to given vectors, produced by the cross product.

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mapping such as z = f(x, y) relating variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Multiple variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Variables such as x and y in multivariable calculus.

extracted_concepts.name: Single-variable differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiation of functions of one variable.

extracted_concepts.name: Partial derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a multivariable function holding other variables fixed.

extracted_concepts.name: Partial derivative with respect to x
aliases: Partial derivative with respect to x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∂f/∂x = lim_{h→0} [f(x+h, y) - f(x, y)] / h.

extracted_concepts.name: Partial derivative with respect to y
aliases: Partial derivative with respect to y
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∂f/∂y = lim_{h→0} [f(x, y+h) - f(x, y)] / h.

extracted_concepts.name: Gradient
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: grad f = (∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y), pointing in the direction of steepest ascent.

extracted_concepts.name: Direction of steepest ascent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Direction in which a function increases fastest.

extracted_concepts.name: Directional derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: D_u f = ∇f · u for a unit direction vector u.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit direction vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector of length 1 specifying a direction.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: How a function value changes with its variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Multivariable chain rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dz/dt = ∂f/∂x · dx/dt + ∂f/∂y · dy/dt.

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding extrema of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Constraint
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation such as g(x, y) = 0 restricting variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Lagrange multipliers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method using ∇f = λ∇g and g(x, y) = 0 for constrained optimization.

extracted_concepts.name: Lagrange multiplier
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalar λ appearing in ∇f = λ∇g.
